acceptance: Red first: a fixture cache with an executable dir unused past the horizon is trimmed, and its bytes count in the cap
Red first: a dir with a mapped file in the injected holder snapshot stays
The report bytes match the sum of the trimmed entries
fix: Treat each `<hash>-d` dir as one entry: its size is the sum of its files, and its use time is the newest mtime inside it. Count it in the cap and the age horizon. Spare a dir that holds a file open or mapped in the LiveHolderProbe snapshot (lsof -F n lists txt and mem fds). Re-check the mtime before each remove.
summary: Plan PR #1585, check K7, decision D12, component X2. TrimGoCache skips each directory entry (go/internal/gc/gocache.go:88). On 2026-11-20, 5,038 `<hash>-d` dirs held 35.9 GB (35.8 GB cached evolve binaries), 30.2 GB unused for 24 hours, while gc reported 20 GB remaining.
title: The Go cache trim counts and trims the cached executable dirs, and spares a held one
